description:
FILED + FIXED s532c (Opus agent, 2026-11-06): the reduction of #3835 (YAML-Tiny's TestML stops "Modification of a read-only value attempted" -- perl runs both files to the end).

    my %h; my @a; my $r = {};
    ($h{a} = "x") .= "y";             print "$h{a}\n";   # perl xy     PCL x
    ($a[0] = 1) += 5;                 print "$a[0]\n";   # perl 6      PCL 1
    ($h{b} = "foo") =~ s/o/0/g;       print "$h{b}\n";   # perl f00    PCL dies read-only
    ($r->{c} = "p q") =~ s/ /_/;      print "$r->{c}\n"; # perl p_q    PCL dies
    "k v" =~ /(\w) (\w)/;
    ($h{$1} = $2) =~ s/v/V/;          print "$h{k}\n";   # perl V      PCL dies (TestML::Tiny::_parse_testml_points: `($block->{$1} = $2) =~ s/^ *(.*?) *$/$1/`)

MECHANISM: perl's value of an assignment is its LEFT side as an lvalue.  The SCALAR spelling already answered the box (`p-my-=` / `p-scalar-=` return the place), but an ELEMENT assignment lowered to `(setf (p-gethash %h k) v)` / `(p-setf (p-gethash-deref $r k) v)`, whose value is the stored VALUE: `=~ s///` then wrote into the right-hand side's value (a literal or the read-only $2 -- the #911 read-only death) and `.=` / `+=` box-set nothing (silent).  `chomp($h{k} = <FH>)` was right because its argument is generated in lvalue context -> `(p-setf (p-gethash-box ...) v)`, and p-setf of a box place answers the box.

FIX (s532c, `Pl/ExprToCL.pm`): `_elem_assign_target_p` (an `=` / `OP=` node, parenthesised or not, whose LHS is an element access -- `_is_elem_lvalue_target`) and the binary-op target rule: a WRITING `=~` / `!~` target or a compound-assignment LHS that is such an assignment is generated in lvalue context, so its place is the element's box.  Guard `Pl/t/elem-assign-lvalue-01.t` (12 shapes vs perl; FAILS on ce665621).

=== COMPLETED (s536, reviewing session, 2026-11-08) === merged as MAIN-READY-74 fcfcb5d3 (s532c); review probes perl -> main 06a4b8ba -> tree (scratchpad p532c/a.pl): tree = perl; no live baseline row keys on this task (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS checked).
subject: SILENT WRONG / spurious die: an assignment TO AN ELEMENT used as an lvalue -- `($h{k} = $2) =~ s///`, `($a[0] = 1) += 5`, `($h{a} = "x") .= "y"` -- edits a copy (or dies "Modification of a read-only value attempted"); perl edits the element (YAML-Tiny 30_yaml_spec_tml.t / 31_local_tml.t, #3835's die)
